mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average signals weakening manufacturing demand, which historically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as profit margins compress.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls > 2% below its 12-month moving average over 3 months
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in weakening demand periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
